### windowShellReservedChordsForUserAgent()

```ts
function windowShellReservedChordsForUserAgent(
  userAgent,
): readonly AppHostReservedChord[];
```

Every chord a shell that owns windows reserves for its App frames: the leader
only. Keys typed inside a frame never reach the shell document, so the leader
must cross it. Alt-arrows stay the frame's own: Option-arrow is word movement in
every Mac text field.

### createAppSurfaceCommandHost()

```ts
function createAppSurfaceCommandHost(whistle?): AppSurfaceCommandHost;
```

Own one shell's Whistle runtime for mounted Apps and local panes. The embedding
host supplies verified Release declarations and decides which App or pane has
focus.

Agar invokes `registerCommands` once for the aggregate command set of a mount.
The adapter keeps that aggregate as one Whistle generation, so an Agar update
replaces the generation atomically and disposal releases only that App. Command
handlers remain the App's callback; the shell only adds the Whistle identity and
routes focused menu execution to it.

#### Parameters

| Parameter | Type             |
| --------- | ---------------- |
| `whistle` | `WhistleRuntime` |

#### Returns

[`AppSurfaceCommandHost`](#appsurfacecommandhost)
